messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bhai ek golden opportunity share karna chahta hoon, sirf close logon ko bata raha hoon.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Gold trading group hai Dubai se signals aate hain. Har member ne 2 mahine mein double kiya hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Double? Kitne ka invest karna parta hai?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Start 20,000 se. Guaranteed returns hain, admin khud insure karta hai. Daily profit screenshot group mein aata hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aaj group band ho raha hai new members ke liye. 20,000 is account number par bhej do: PK00XXXX000055667788, slot lock ho jaye ga.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Ruk thora, main behen se pooch ke batata hoon.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Raat tak slots khatam. Aur bhai yeh group ka secret hai, kisi ko na batana warna membership cancel — rules hain.
